messages:
alex: Heads-up: planning a small infra deploy today 16:30 PT. Main changes are observability-only — dashboard panel tweaks, bumping a couple alert thresholds, and temporarily increasing trace sampling to 100% for ~30m for one prefix. No code changes. Owner: alex. Rollback: revert config PR.

maya: Which alerts exactly? tagging SRE folks. Also is this during the release window?

jun: I can run preflight and smoke checks right after — can do 16:35 PT. What load profile should I use?

alex: Alerts to adjust: `infer_latency_p99` currently 4500ms -> set to 5200ms for non-prod traffic; `queue_depth_total` from 80 -> 120. Trace sample rate: increase from 0.05 -> 1.0 for `canary/obs-tune` prefix for 30m. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/obs-tune

maya: Dashboards to watch: "Serving Latency (p50/p90/p99)", "Queue Depth by pool", "Trace Error Rate". I'll pin those.

sam_ops: I'm on-call 16:00-18:00 — I'll monitor and can initiate rollback if we see >3 elevated errors in 5m. Add me to the rollback owner list. @alex please assign.

lia: Left a couple minor review comments on the PR re: sampling scope. If storage/cost spikes, rollback criteria should be explicit. Suggest adding a temporary billing alert or lowering the window to 15m for the first run.

jun: For smoke I'll run a 5m 5rps steady pattern targeting canary routes then a 30s spike to validate autoscaling. Command I'll run: `k6 run smoke.js -e target=canary -d 5m`

alex: Deploy command (what ops will execute):
```
./scripts/deploy-config.sh --env prod --config infra/obs/obs-tune.json
```
Post-deploy checks: `./tools/check_alerts.sh --since now-10m` and open the latency p99 panel. If any panel shows sustained deviation >10% and we hit the error threshold, rollback immediately. Rollback command: `./scripts/revert-config.sh --pr 4321`

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for 1790123400 by alex: infra/obs/obs-tune. Status: queued.

maya: I'll subscribe #incidents and escalate to Pager if needed. Also pinging @sam_ops and @jun in case we need rapid retries. :thumbsup:

alex: TL;DR: 16:30 PT small observability config push, owners alex + sam_ops, smoke by jun at 16:35, watch panels above, rollback if >3 errors in 5m or cost spike. I'll post a short follow-up when it's live.

lia: Thanks — will monitor traces and cost. If anything looks off I'll post in this thread and @sam_ops will take action.
